Absolute cross-SDK byte golden for bigint state values -127 / +127 (construct-ledger row `state-bigint-edges`, plan Phase D3). Same StateBigintEdges artifact, different constructor args, so the fixture family pins the whole documented edge set rather than one sample. DERIVATION (from the encoding rule, not from serializeState): a bigint state field is OP_NUM2BIN(n, 8) — a fixed 8-byte LITTLE-ENDIAN SIGN-MAGNITUDE word, magnitude in bytes 0..6 LE, sign in bit 0x80 of byte 7. |127| = 0x7f -> LE 7f 00 00 00 00 00 00 00; sign sets bit 0x80 of byte 7 -> `7f00000000000080`, positive -> `7f00000000000000`.
